policy.name: student-fortress-mirror-mixture-template-v1-normal
policy.description: Use original Fortress for existing accepted tickets 0–4 and its complete horizontal mirror for tickets 5–9 in Classic Normal; no new RNG draw or move-policy change.
policy.model: Unchanged public eight-template 80% plus uniform 20% Flag/Bomb inference and native Student movement. Own complete formation selected by five of ten existing accepted setup tickets per orientation in Classic Normal only. Flag/Spy reflect with all own ranks. No new random draws. Accepted raw ticket values split 32,765/32,765; uniform nonzero initial seed enumeration 32,766/32,769 due inherited deterministic retries.
policy.information_model: Own army, public events and declared source-informed population prior only. Deployment orientation depends on own existing setup ticket only; no opponent layout, private opponent seed or concealed rank input.

policy.name: MS-DOS Stratego 1990 v2 / Colonel (fast)
policy.description: Original 1990 16-bit AI with fast native-block JIT execution and per-call watchdog. Colonel3; original hidden-rank knowledge retained, Classic referee, common deployments. Exact state/choice parity with v1 checked; not full DOS UI emulation.
policy.information_model: Original physical-rank access, including hidden Flag/Spy and other original disclosure paths. Opponent initial army supplied only to this reference adapter.
